column.spell: the spell itself — its name, what it says it does, its icon, and how it casts
column.id: the spell's own number, and the expansion that introduced it
column.model: the 3D models a spell draws — missiles, ground effects, attachments
column.sound: the sound files a spell plays, and the kits they come from
column.anim: how the character moves — replacements, kits, loose animations
column.fx: what the spell looks like — beams, glows, tints, morphs, size changes
column.mech: what the spell does — effects, auras, timing, links and gates

operator.exact: exactly this, matching the whole value
operator.glob: a pattern, where * stands for any run of characters
operator.regex: a regular expression between slashes, matched case-insensitively

type.text: words, matched anywhere in the text unless anchored with =
type.path: part of a file path; file names run words together, so bee also finds beer
type.enum: one of a fixed list of names; pick one, or type part of it
type.ordinal: one of an ordered set of names; name one, or compare with < and >
type.count: how many, as a whole number or a comparison such as >4
type.seconds: a duration in seconds, such as 1.5, 500ms, or 2-5
type.percent: a percentage, such as 50 or 7.5, or a range like 10-90
type.percentChange: a change such as +50, a factor such as 2 or x1.5, or 150 as a proportion of the original
type.length: a distance in yards, such as 5 or 10-40
type.coordinate: a distance along one axis in yards, which may be negative
type.angle: an angle in degrees, such as 60 or 27-60
type.colour: a colour as #rrggbb or a name such as red; a bare colour matches nearby shades too
type.offset: a point as x,y,z in yards; name one member such as z=3, or leave a component blank to ignore it
type.bitmask: who it plays on: caster, target, both, area or others
type.flag: either the spell has it or it does not

icon.hint: the art on the spell's button

delivery.hint: how the spell goes off — at once, behind a cast bar, or as a channel

props.unbreakable: moving and acting do not break it
props.unhindered: the caster can act while channelling
props.tracking: the caster stays facing the target while channelling

props.yards: the furthest a target can stand
props.melee: reaches the caster's own combat reach

barrage.hint: a volley of models fired at once

ground.hint: a ground or area model laid on the world

worn.hint: a model stuck to the caster or the target

props.attach: the body point it sits on

trail.hint: a weapon trail that follows a swing

display.hint: a creature display drawn on the caster or target

props.attach: the body point it anchors to

item.hint: an in-game item's model, held by the caster

props.name: the item's name
props.attach: the body point it is held at

equipped.hint: a weapon the caster already carries

props.attach: the body point it is held at

mount.hint: the mount it puts you on

sound.hint: a sound file the spell plays

animKit.hint: an animation played through a numbered kit

loose.hint: an animation played directly, outside any kit

passenger.hint: what a rider plays entering, sitting in and leaving a seat

chain.hint: a chain or beam held between two points

props.attach: the body point it plays at

shadowy.hint: a translucent shadow pass over the model

props.attach: the body point it plays at

ghost.hint: a ghost material swapped onto the model

glow.hint: an edge glow around the model

tint.hint: a colour wash over the model

desaturate.hint: how much colour is drained from the model

freeze.hint: freezes or petrifies the model in place

morph.hint: a morph aura — the caster becomes something else

shapeshift.hint: a shapeshift form the caster takes

scale.hint: a size change the aura applies

screen.hint: a full-screen tint or overlay while the aura holds

effect.hint: one of the spell's effects — what it actually does

aura.hint: an aura the spell applies — what it does while it holds

triggers.hint: another spell this one casts, ticks, procs or removes

origin.hint: a spell that casts, ticks, procs or removes this one

location.hint: the places the spell is allowed to work in

invis.hint: the invisibility channel the aura hides in

props.count: how many spells hide in it

vehicle.hint: the vehicle the caster becomes, and its seats

keybind.hint: a key that casts a spell while the aura holds

debuff.hint: aura that shows in the red debuff frame
